Lightning and thunder happen when electricity travels from one part of the sky to another
The sky is like an electrical battery
When there is a big change in temperature, like warm air rushing up and cold air rushing down, electrons zip right past each other and make a flash of lightning
Sometimes, when a cloud gets too hot, it splits into two small clouds that zoom right past each other, making a huge boom
claims.note: Clouds do not get too hot and split into two clouds to create thunder; thunder is caused by the rapid expansion of air heated by lightning.
